legend.soundAtlas.title: Soundscape (experimental)
legend.soundAtlas.link: Lines: listening point to source (aircraft = ground projection, dashed)
legend.soundAtlas.wavefront: Thunder wavefront: grows 343 m per second (illustrative, not a sound-pressure extent)
legend.soundAtlas.animation: Ripples, receiver pulse rings, raindrop rings and music notes only illustrate that a source is active now; their size and speed scale with relative potential, not sound-pressure range. Grey dashed ring = cannot determine
legend.soundAtlas.rail: Trains (surface/elevated, scheduled): underground sections are silent; sections of unknown structure show as unknown
legend.soundAtlas.roadTraffic: Road-type proxy (national freeways only, no traffic volume); other roads: no data
legend.soundAtlas.roadwork: Roadwork permit period (possible activity; a permit is not machinery running); Taipei City and other non-publishing cities: not covered
legend.soundAtlas.attribution: Sources: rail structure © OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL); roadwork TDX city planned events; roads TDX freeway conditions (congestion level, not volume)
